title: Kafka

fields.name: brokers
fields.description: Single or multiple list of Kafka Brokers, e.g: 192.168.1.3:9092, 192.168.1.4:9092.

fields.name: topics
fields.description: Single entry or list of topics separated by comma (,) that Fluent Bit will subscribe to.

fields.name: poll_ms
fields.description: Kafka brokers polling interval in milliseconds.

fields.name: buffer_max_size
fields.description: Specify the maximum size of buffer per cycle to poll kafka messages from subscribed topics.

fields.name: threaded
fields.description: Indicates whether to run this input in its own [thread](/manual/3.2/administration/multithreading.md#inputs).

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Tag assigned to records emitted by this input plugin.
